112.long_description:
Street Fighter 6 arcade machine is possible via any Arcooda Game Wizard arcade machine. Just install your PC, XBOX X/S, Playstation 4, or PlayStation 5 for full plug and play arcade experience.

With Street Fighter 6, players will be able to take their skills around the world in search of their own personal strength. 

No one starts off as a champion. Even the strongest of fighters had to take that first step. Now it's your turn to take up the challenge and bring your game to the next level.

Arcooda machines are designed for true arcade game play, Sanwa joystick and buttons, gaming monitors, strong full sized arcade cabinets for dual game play. 

In the below demo we are showing Street Fighter 6 being played on PC via Steam on the Tempest sitdown 32inch arcade machine.
